{{Quote|This Farandan - I should warn you, he's wearing a Rebel Alliance uniform. But trust me, he's not a Rebel. Hey, I'm not trying to start a political discussion here; he's just not, that's all.|Bren Kingal|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Jespral Farandan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was killed by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by [[Bren Kingal]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SharpshooterMaleTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Jespral Farandan]]
[[File:SharpshooterFemaleTemplate.png|250px|thumb|Randomly generated female depictions, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Jespral Farandan was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Due to the nature of many older quests in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the [[Species/Legends|species]] and appearance of Jespral Farandan changed each time a player performed this quest. The quest dialogue given by Bren Kingal indicated that Farandan was a male, but no mention was made of his species. Therefore, the [[canon]]ical species of Farandan remains unidentified, but he could have been a [[Human/Legends|Human]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], or any other number of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species. Furthermore, although not mentioned in the quest dialogue, examining Farandan revealed him to be a [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]]. However, it should be noted that this was primarily due to game mechanics, as a result of Farandan being placed under the randomized sharpshooter spawn template appearance.
